answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require a refundable 120 POA bond locked for 60 days plus 20 verified jobs before reputation counts, like a falcon that earns its perch instead of a glacier of identical clones floating down one river. An attacker spawning 1,000 fake identities must lock 120,000 POA for two months and finish 20,000 verified jobs, and if two identities share one payment fingerprint both bonds are slashed in full.
